pakete.mitgeliefert.folge.ablago.text: Without “Text from PDF and text recognition”, Ablago no longer reads the text of new PDFs; the search then only finds them by name and fields.
pakete.mitgeliefert.folge.ablago.archiv: Without “Archive version (PDF/A)”, Ablago no longer takes originals that already are PDF/A as their archive version.
pakete.mitgeliefert.folge.ablago.umwande: Without “Convert”, Ablago no longer makes a PDF from photos (JPEG, PNG) on request.
pakete.mitgeliefert.folge.ablago.pdf: Without “Edit PDF”, pages can no longer be rotated, arranged, split or merged, PDFs no longer shrunk and documents no longer redacted.
pakete.mitgeliefert.folge.ablago.briefsa: Without “Letter layout”, no more letters are created from text or templates.
pakete.mitgeliefert.folge.ablago.erechnu: Without “Read e-invoice”, Ablago no longer recognises e-invoices (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD) and fills no fields from them.
